description: Single-shot LLM agent via Vercel AI Gateway — OpenAI-compatible proxy that routes to any provider with unified billing + automatic fallback + Vercel observability.

mcp_servers.label: Mcp Servers
mcp_servers.description: MCP servers to expose as tools. Each entry is declared inline (name + transport fields) or shared via server_resource_key (an MCPServerResource component's resource_key) -- exactly one of the two per entry.

name.description: Tool-name prefix. Required when declaring the server inline; leave unset when using server_resource_key.

url.description: http / sse: full URL of the MCP endpoint.

server_resource_key.description: Resource key of an MCPServerResource component to use instead of declaring this server inline -- lets several agent components share one registered server. Exactly one of `name` (inline spec) or `server_resource_key` is required.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning-model effort level: 'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high'. Forwarded to OpenAI o-series (openai/o1, openai/o3) and Gemini 2.5+ (google/gemini-2.5-*) via the Vercel gateway. Filtered client-side by provider prefix; ignored for other providers.

thinking_budget.label: Thinking Budget
thinking_budget.description: Max reasoning-trace tokens. Forwarded as `thinking_budget` for Gemini 2.5+ models or `thinking: {type: enabled, budget_tokens: N}` for Anthropic models routed through the gateway. Ignored for other providers.

prompt_caching.label: Prompt Caching
prompt_caching.description: Anthropic prompt caching. When true AND the model prefix is 'anthropic/', wraps the system prompt with `cache_control: {type: ephemeral}` so subsequent calls within ~5 min hit the cache. Ignored for non-Anthropic models. Vercel forwards the block through to Anthropic.
